summary: Glue records give the addresses of name servers that live inside the zone they serve, so resolvers can find them. This document clarifies that authoritative servers should return all available in-domain glue in referral responses. If it does not fit, the server must set the TC (truncated) bit so the client retries over another transport. It updates RFC 1034.

eli5.summary: If directions to a house are on a map inside the house, you can't find the house. Glue puts a note outside. If the note is too long, say "too long, ask again with a bigger page."

questions: when to set tc bit dns referral
